title: Contributors
sub: The students who made this site possible.

groups.title: Thank you
groups.intro: Without these students, this site would not be possible. They shared their notes, papers, recordings and time so that the next batch can prepare well. Thank you, every one of you.

missing.text: Forgot to add your name, or want a link changed? Message me on Discourse and I will fix it.

contribute.title: Want to contribute?
contribute.intro: This site is kept by students, and every course page can get better. Here are three easy ways to help.

cards.title: Share a resource
cards.text: Notes, previous year papers, playlists or any link that helped you. Send the link with the course name and how you want to be credited.
cards.label: Message on Discourse

cards.title: Report a broken link or a mistake
cards.text: Wrong date, dead link, missing course detail or a typo. A short note saying which page and what to change is enough.
cards.label: Message on Discourse

cards.title: Add it yourself
cards.text: The whole site is open on GitHub. Each course is one small data file, so adding a link is a short change you can send as a pull request.
cards.label: View on GitHub
